stories.headline: India clinch first women's hockey gold since 1982 at Asiad; seal LA28 Olympics spot
stories.title: India clinch first women's hockey gold since 1982 at Asiad; seal LA28 Olympics spot
stories.summary: It was the women's hockey team's first medal at the continental event since winning their only gold in 1982. India ended a 44-year wait with the win over defending champions China and also secured direct qualification for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

stories.headline: Yamuna Expressway Bus Fire : Supreme Court Seeks Report From Centre, UP On Arrests, Safety Compliance
stories.title: Yamuna Expressway Bus Fire : Supreme Court Seeks Report From Centre, UP On Arrests, Safety Compliance
reasons: corroboration: single independent source -> medium confidence
event term: 'supreme court' in title weight 44
article_sentences: The Supreme Court has sought responses from the Uttar Pradesh Government and the Centre on a plea seeking a series of road safety measures following the death of nine passengers who were charred to death in a sleeper bus fire near Jewar on the Yamuna Expressway during the intervening night of September 23 and 24, 2026.

It has asked the Chief Secretary, Government of Uttar Pradesh, the Union of India, and the Secretary of the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) to respond on whether the driver and the owner of the bus have been arrested or not.
It has also sought information on whether the registered owner had complied with the rules and regulations applied to the double-decker bus.
The matter was considered by a bench comprising Justice JB Pardiwala and Justice KV Viswanathan in S. Rajaseekaran.
Union of India, a 2012 writ petition seeking directions on road safety, on an interlocutory application(IA).
It ordered: "We would like to know what steps have been taken against the driver of the bus concerned, including the registered owner of the bus.
Whether they have been arrested so far?
Whether the registered owner had complied with all rules and regulations before plying this double-decker bus on road?"
The application seeks a detailed report from the Uttar Pradesh Chief Secretary on the circumstances surrounding the fire.

It has sought information on the cause of the fire, ownership and registration details of the bus, its permit, fitness certificate, insurance and authorised passenger capacity, besides compliance with construction and fire-safety requirements.

The report is also expected to cover any unauthorised alterations to the vehicle, the working condition of emergency exits and safety devices, the challan and violation history of the vehicle, operator and driver, and the response time of the police, fire services, ambulance and expressway authorities.
It also seeks details of action taken against those responsible and a time-bound preventive action plan.
